All boundary and strict-definiteness conditions are treated. Standalone verifier passes 3727 rational/numerical assertions; finite tests are supplemental.

Because all diagonal entries equal one, diagonal-only importance sampling would be uniform yet generally suboptimal; the theorem supplies the unique optimum and exact contraction constant for every dimension and admissible pair of correlations. The precise phase switch has independent mathematical value without asserting downstream application gains.
